definitions.gloss: impudently clever; cunning; shrewd in an annoying way
definitions.explanation: Describes someone who is clever in a petty, irritating way — using small tricks or manipulations rather than genuine intelligence.

examples.japanese: {小賢|こざか}しい⟦{真似|まね}→真似：03736_mane⟧はやめろ。

examples.english: That kid says annoyingly clever things.

examples.japanese: {小賢|こざか}しい⟦{手段|しゅだん}→手段：03219_shudan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{騙|だま}そう→騙す：02286_damasu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦やつ→やつ：10782_yatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{信用|しんよう}できない→信用する：25371_shinyousuru⟧。
examples.english: You can't trust someone who tries to fool people with petty cunning.

notes:
The prefix ⟦{小|こ}→小〜：00240_ko⟧ adds a diminutive, contemptuous nuance to ⟦{賢|かしこ}い→賢い：00192_kashikoi⟧ (clever, smart). While ⟦{賢|かしこ}い→賢い：00192_kashikoi⟧ is positive, {小賢|こざか}しい is always negative — it implies cleverness that is petty, irritating, or presumptuous.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小賢|こざか}しい⟦{真似|まね}→真似：03736_mane⟧: petty tricks
- {小賢|こざか}しい⟦{手段|しゅだん}→手段：03219_shudan⟧: cunning methods
- {小賢|こざか}しいこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to say annoyingly clever things
- {小賢|こざか}しい{子|こ}ども: a precociously clever child (pejorative)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{賢|かしこ}い→賢い：00192_kashikoi⟧: clever, smart — positive evaluation
- ⟦{狡|ずる}い→狡い：03929_zurui⟧: sly, cunning — focuses on unfair advantage
- ⟦{生意気|なまいき}→生意気：08271_namaiki⟧: cheeky, impudent — focuses on disrespect toward superiors
